review.summary: Round 2 reviewed the round 1 fix commit and re-checked the whole branch from the base. The AI Via MCP bullet in ARCHITECTURE.md now says the trailing-slash MCP spelling answers 404 without Location, and the MCP Server Harness list in docs/TESTING.md names the trailing-slash 404, no-Location and no-store cases with and without a token; both match the code and tests. The MCP trailing-slash test now covers GET and POST on both servers with and without a valid token, with redirect-following off. The auth and MCP auth test files pass (84 tests). Turning the app-level flag back on made all 12 trailing-slash cases fail, and the working tree was restored afterwards. Ruff check passes, the changed Python files are formatted and pyright reports 0 errors. The branch still changes no dependency, Caddyfile, Compose, Dockerfile or proxy-trust code, and no round 2 change touches application code, so the round 1 conclusions on route coverage, trailing-slash dependencies and request-derived redirects still hold. Noted as cosmetic and not a finding: one edited ARCHITECTURE.md line exceeds 80 characters, as about 20 existing lines there do, and CI does not lint Markdown.
